profile.headline: Application Software Development Analyst
profile.summary:
Multi-disciplined software engineer with seven+ years of experience designing, developing, and implementing solutions with a wide range of technologies and programming languages.

• Innovative Spirit: Experiments with emerging software and technologies beyond the scope of academic learning out of pure love for programming. 

• Family Oriented: Committed and dependable husband, father, and sibling for the wellbeing and prosperity of others. 

• Community-Focused: Volunteer in non-profit community originations.

• Servants Heart: Served in the United States Air Force and current member in Arizona Air National Guard.
